sanjay (sec-eng): heads up — external pentest scheduled Mon 2026-03-09 10:00-18:00 UTC. Need RBAC temporary roles, KMS assessor access, and an audit export path. Listing owners and blockers now.

alex (infra-ops): assigned for RBAC + S3. What's the exact role TTL? can we use 8h?

maria (infra): we can create an ephemeral role via STS assume-role with duration 28800s (8h). We'll need the principal AWS account ids for the assessors.

sanjay (sec-eng): assessor account ids: 123456789012 and 210987654321. RBAC mapping: allow assume-role but restrict access to resources with tag "pentest=true". Also we should scope KMS decrypt to a single wrap key and use grants for lifecycle control.

jason (app-eng): for KMS I'd prefer a short-lived grant during the window rather than permanent policy changes. Example (illustrative):
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowAssessorDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor" },
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

maria (infra): +1 for grants. We'll create a grant at test start and revoke immediately after. less policy churn.

sanjay (sec-eng): Audit logs requirement: ops, export CloudTrail + CloudWatch logs to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1766000000/ and set retention 365d. Events to collect: kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, iam:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject. Need proof-of-export and manifest.

ops-oncall (oncall): copy paste command for manual export if needed:
```
aws s3 cp /aws-cloudtrail-logs s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1766000000/ --recursive
```

tori (compliance): retention 365d ok from compliance side. Also require a chain-of-custody text file in evidence.zip listing who handled artifacts and timestamps.

sec-bot: Ticket created: PT-2026-042; evidence bucket redwood-pt-evidence/1766000000 created and initial bucket policy applied. (automated)

alex (infra-ops): I'll create role `pt-assessor` with Trust policy allowing those assessor accounts to assume and tag ttl=8h. Adding to infra runbook with assume-role snippet and TTL enforcement.

maria (infra): presigned upload URL will be created for evidence.zip and rotated after upload. Example flow: presign -> assessor uploads -> we copy to locked bucket path and enable object lock/versioning.

jason (app-eng): vuln triage workflow reminder — post initial findings to #vuln-triage using this template:
- vuln id
- severity
- repro steps
- logs / evidence path (s3 path)
- owner
- ETA for fix
This keeps retest owners clear.

sanjay (sec-eng): retest coordination: propose 2-day retest window one week after test (week of 2026-03-16). Ops, can you block that and ensure oncall coverage? Also want a canary rollback plan documented for any infra/config changes.

ops-oncall (oncall): ack — blocking 2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-17 09:00-18:00 UTC for retest. Pager handoff included. I'll add a short checklist to the oncall playbook for escalations.

tori (compliance): evidence must include KMS grant lifecycle proof: grant create timestamp, grant ID, actor, and revoke timestamp. That will be required for audit sign-off.

alex (infra-ops): doing a pre-test dry-run tomorrow 2026-03-08 15:00 UTC to validate role assume, KMS grant create/revoke, and presigned upload. Invite sent to @sanjay @maria @jason.

sanjay (sec-eng): perfect. Any blockers?

jason (app-eng): one ask — dev caches use a different key (local dev key). We'll produce a key mapping table in the evidence manifest: service -> key-id and note which keys are in-scope.

maria (infra): noted. I'll add key mapping and a short checklist to the evidence manifest: keys.csv, manifest.json, chain_of_custody.txt.

sanjay (sec-eng): thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this plan ready and hand off to ops. :thumbsup:

alex (infra-ops): :thumbsup:

sec-bot: PT-2026-042 status: ready_for_test (automated)
